The '''Great Kimogila's Skeleton''' was the name given by the inhabitants of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to the imposing skeleton of a massive [[kimogila]]. The final resting place of the creature was known as a notable point of interests of the planet Lok.<ref name="SWG:GKS" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Force Adept]] explored the area and collected an ancient [[Force artifact/Legends|Force relic]] for [[Loisya Starkos]].<ref name="SWG:RmR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Replacing my Robe|Dathomir}}</ref> Later, a spacer working with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Balfur Jhcor]] killed the wanted [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Oono Mor'in]] near the Great Kimogila's Skeleton.<ref name="SWG:BBP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bounty By Proxy|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Kimogila's Skeleton was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GKS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
